bundle.shortDescription: Explore SQL Server and PostgreSQL schemas as interactive diagrams
bundle.longDescription: SchemaCraft reads SQL Server and PostgreSQL schema metadata into portable .scraft projects. Explore interactive entity-relationship diagrams and known dependencies, compare captures, save perspectives and notes, and export SVG, PNG, PDF and self-contained HTML.
